answer: In each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake, joins a Semaphore zero-knowledge tree, and evaluates a committed epoch polynomial to derive an RLN rate-limit identity. A valid message proves membership without exposing the identity; duplicate messages produce correlated shares, and Shamir reconstruction reveals the private key, enabling instantaneous on-chain collateral slashing. Thus sybil identities become costly: at any nadir, no identity may wander beyond the protocol’s haven.
